### Plates, sheets, chequered plate, flats and bars (catalogue unit weights)
- Plate / sheet (EN10025 S275/S355): **7.85 kg per m² per mm** thickness -> kg = L(m) x W(m) x t(mm) x 7.85.
- Chequered plate (3-12 mm): **8.08 kg per m² per mm** (catalogue figure; includes the raised pattern) -> kg = L x W x t x 8.08.
- Flat bar (3-25 mm x 12-300 mm): kg/m = t x w x 0.00785 (catalogue values follow this exactly, e.g. 10x100 = 7.85).
- Round bar: kg/m = 0.006165 x d²; square bar: kg/m = 0.00785 x a².
